translate_en|mods/BetterBuildingPlus/42/: Lock a whole category with its padlock, or pick a category and lock single types or materials inside it.

Click a padlock to lock a kit. A built-in kit locks only the tiles found in that kind of building alone; plain walls other kits share stay buildable. Your own kits (starred) lock every tile in them. Click names to pick rows (Ctrl adds, Shift picks a range), then Lock or Unlock them together.
Staff roles can always build everything. Everyone else is refused locked tiles.

When on, only admins can plan, save, start or build blueprints. Changing it in-game takes effect at once, no restart needed. Constructions already under way pause until it is turned off.
When on, players see a Disassemble building option on blueprint-built buildings and can take them down for part of their materials. Off by default.

When off, players who are not admins never load the Appliances tiles into their building catalog, whatever they pick in Mod Options. Every loaded tile costs memory, so turn off groups your server does not need if players run out of memory. The basic wooden walls, floors, doors, windows, roofs and stairs always stay, and admins are not affected.

Share of the materials a building cost that come back when it is disassembled. They are dropped on the ground where it stood, nails packed into boxes. Pieces built with the admin build cheat give nothing back.
When enabled, an entire blueprint can be built in a single stationary action. Materials are still consumed unless the admin build cheat is on.

The build menu fills up as you level Carpentry: crude walls at first, everything sensible by level 7, and faster building above it. Electrical work needs Electrical skill. Magazines and studying built examples unlock pieces early.

With build cheat on it removes everything, walls and furniture included. Not allowed inside someone else's safehouse. This cannot be undone.
